name: Campingplatz Riegsee
beschreibung: The Riegsee campsite is located in Murnau am Staffelsee in the Tiroler Oberland. The surroundings are characterized by the pre-alpine landscape and the proximity to the Staffelsee. The site offers pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. The facilities include sanitary facilities, electricity connections and a supply and disposal station. The atmosphere at the campsite is described as quiet and close to nature. The Riegsee itself can be used for swimming and water sports in summer. Hikes into the nearby Ammergauer Alpen are possible directly from here. The campsite is therefore particularly suitable for families and guests who prefer a quiet accommodation in nature.
